references.text: Elisama, son of Ammihud, is mentioned again as the leader of the tribe of Ephraim during the camp arrangement.
Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the camp arrangement.
Elisama, son of Ammihud, brings his offering as the leader of the tribe of Ephraim at the dedication of the altar.
Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur, brings his offering as the leader of the tribe of Manasseh at the dedication of the altar.
Elisama and Gamaliel are mentioned again as leaders of their respective tribes during the departure from Sinai.
Joseph and his sons Ephraim and Manasseh are blessed by Jacob, which explains why Joseph's tribe is divided into two.
Ephraim and Manasseh are born as Joseph's sons in Egypt, and their names are explained.
Joseph's descendants (Ephraim and Manasseh) receive their inheritance in the promised land.
